name: Product Announcer
author: sjrubel10

sections.description:
Product Announcer is a feature-packed WooCommerce plugin designed to automate email notifications and enhance user experience on your WordPress store. Whether it’s notifying customers about new products, low stock, or personalized recommendations, this plugin helps drive customer engagement and maximize sales.

Key Features:

Automated Email Notifications

Keep your customers informed with instant email alerts for new product launches, special deals, and stock updates.

Real-Time Product Sales Display

Showcase the number of products sold within a specified timeframe directly on product pages to build customer confidence and highlight demand.

New Arrival Notifications

Let customers subscribe to updates about new arrivals in specific categories, keeping them informed and engaged with the store’s latest products.

Countdown Timers for Promotions

Add eye-catching countdown timers to product pages for flash sales or upcoming launches, creating urgency and excitement.

Out-of-Stock Popups with Restock Requests

Engage users with popups when products go out of stock, allowing them to request restocks and stay updated.

Low Stock Alerts

Automatically notify customers when a product’s stock level is running low, encouraging faster purchases.

Back-in-Stock Notifications

Let customers sign up for alerts when sold-out items are replenished, keeping them connected to your store.

Post-Purchase Review Requests

Automate follow-up emails to request reviews, enhancing trust and attracting new buyers.

Abandoned Cart Recovery

Recover lost sales with targeted email reminders for incomplete checkouts.

Personalized Recommendations

Use AI-powered algorithms to suggest products based on customers’ browsing or purchase history.

Wishlist Notifications

Send timely alerts when items in users’ wishlists go back in stock or go on sale.

Actionable Sales Analytics

Analyze sales trends and product performance to make data-driven business decisions.

Dynamic Flash Sale Announcements

Promote flash sales effectively with customizable banners and notifications.

Customizable Email Templates

Design branded email templates with your logo, images, and personalized messages to enhance communication.

Recent Sales Popups

Build trust with dynamic popups displaying real-time purchase activity.

Scheduled Notifications

Plan and schedule notifications to align with marketing campaigns and maximize their impact.

Social Media Sharing Options

Allow customers to share their purchases or new product alerts easily on social media, increasing the store’s visibility and potential reach.

VIP or Exclusive Offers

Create a VIP email list for loyal customers to receive exclusive product announcements and special deals, adding a sense of exclusivity.

Thank You Messages

Strengthen customer loyalty with automated post-purchase thank-you emails.

With seamless WordPress integration and SEO-friendly functionality, Product Announcer is your all-in-one solution for customer engagement.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the product-announcer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the settings panel to configure notifications and customize email templates.
sections.faq:
Why choose Product Announcer?

This plugin streamlines customer communication with automatic notifications, helping you boost sales and improve user experience on WooCommerce stores.

How do I configure email notifications?

Install and activate the plugin, then visit the settings page to customize email templates and configure notification preferences.

Can I customize email templates?

Yes! Easily tailor email designs with your branding, images, and personalized messages.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce?

Absolutely. Product Announcer integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce, enhancing its functionality for your store.
